noProject.title: No project open
noProject.description: Open or create a project to see its repository.

noFolder.title: No project folder
noFolder.description: This project is not linked to a folder on disk yet. Set its root folder to use Git and snapshots.

notRepo.title: Not a Git repository
notRepo.description: {{path}} is not under version control yet. Initialize a repository to track changes, branches and agent worktrees.

branchName.chars: Contains characters Git does not allow.

binary.title: Binary file
binary.description: Binary files cannot be shown as a text diff.

tooLarge.title: File too large
tooLarge.description: Files over 8 MiB are not shown in the diff viewer.

changes.discarded_one: Discarded {{count}} file. A safety snapshot was taken — restore it from the Snapshots tab.
changes.discarded_other: Discarded {{count}} files. A safety snapshot was taken — restore it from the Snapshots tab.
changes.mergeInProgress: A merge is in progress. Resolve conflicts and commit, or abort.
changes.messagePlaceholderEmpty: Stage changes, then write a commit message
changes.cleanText: Nothing to commit — the working tree matches HEAD.
changes.emptyDiff: Select a changed file to compare it side by side.
changes.discardDescription: Unstaged edits are reverted and untracked files are deleted. Orkestr takes a safety snapshot first, so this can be undone from the Snapshots tab.

empty.title: No commits yet
empty.description: Commit your first changes from the Changes tab.

history.emptyDiff: Pick a commit, then a file, to see what changed.

branches.mergeConflicts_one: Merge stopped with conflicts in {{count}} file
branches.mergeConflicts_other: Merge stopped with conflicts in {{count}} files
branches.name: New branch name

empty.title: No branches yet
empty.description: Branches appear after the first commit.

branches.forceDescription: This branch has commits that are not merged anywhere. Deleting it may lose them (its last commit id is shown after deletion).
branches.deleteDescription: Only merged branches can be deleted safely.
branches.mergeDescription: A merge commit is always created (--no-ff).
branches.previewUpToDate: Already up to date — nothing to merge.
branches.previewClean_one: No conflicts. {{count}} commit will be merged.
branches.previewClean_other: No conflicts. {{count}} commits will be merged.
branches.previewConflicts: Conflicts predicted in: {{files}}. Resolve them on the branch first.

worktrees.removedSnapshot: Worktree removed. Its uncommitted changes were saved in a safety snapshot.
worktrees.hint: Agents automatically get their own worktree on {{pattern}}; they never write into your checkout.
worktrees.dirtyDescription: This worktree has uncommitted changes. They will be saved in a safety snapshot, then the worktree is force-removed. The branch is kept.
worktrees.cleanDescription: The directory is removed; the branch and its commits are kept.

snapshots.noTarget: There is no snapshot to roll back to yet — create one first.
snapshots.restored: Restored {{path}}. A safety snapshot was taken first.
snapshots.hint: Snapshots include uncommitted and untracked files and never touch Git history.

empty.title: No snapshots yet
empty.description: Take one before risky changes — Orkestr also snapshots automatically before discards and rollbacks.

snapshots.rollbackTo: Roll back workspace to this snapshot…
snapshots.emptyDiffSelected: Pick a changed file to compare the snapshot with the current version.
snapshots.emptyDiff: Select a snapshot to preview it.
snapshots.restoreDescription: The current file is replaced with its version from “{{label}}”. A safety snapshot is taken first.
snapshots.deleteDescription: The snapshot record is removed; files in your workspace are not touched.

rollback.done: Rolled back to “{{label}}”: {{restored}} restored, {{deleted}} deleted. Undo by rolling back to the pre-rollback snapshot.
rollback.doneSkipped: Rolled back to “{{label}}”: {{restored}} restored, {{deleted}} deleted, {{skipped}} skipped (changed meanwhile). Undo by rolling back to the pre-rollback snapshot.
rollback.title: Roll back workspace to “{{label}}”?
rollback.description: {{time}} · {{files}}. Orkestr takes a safety snapshot first, so this can be undone.
rollback.deleteCreated: Also delete files created after the snapshot
rollback.alreadyMatches: The workspace already matches this snapshot.

reason.createdKept: created after the snapshot — kept (turn on “Also delete files created after the snapshot” to remove it)
